mapper.select: SELECT USER_NUM, EMAIL, PASSWD, USER_NAME, REAL_NAME, PHONE, BIRTH, INTRO, PHOTO_NAME, AUTH, LOGIN_TYPE, GOOGLE_ID, STATUS, WITHDRAW_DATE, REG_DATE, MODIFY_DATE FROM USERS WHERE GOOGLE_ID = #{googleId} AND STATUS != 3

SELECT USER_NUM, EMAIL, PASSWD, USER_NAME, REAL_NAME, PHONE, BIRTH, INTRO, PHOTO_NAME, AUTH, LOGIN_TYPE, GOOGLE_ID, STATUS, WITHDRAW_DATE, REG_DATE, MODIFY_DATE FROM USERS WHERE LOWER(EMAIL) = #{email} AND STATUS != 3

SELECT USER_NUM, EMAIL, PASSWD, USER_NAME, REAL_NAME, PHONE, BIRTH, INTRO, PHOTO_NAME, AUTH, LOGIN_TYPE, GOOGLE_ID, STATUS, WITHDRAW_DATE, REG_DATE, MODIFY_DATE FROM USERS WHERE USER_NUM = #{userNum} AND STATUS != 3
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERS ( USER_NUM, EMAIL, PASSWD, USER_NAME, REAL_NAME, PHONE, BIRTH, INTRO, AUTH, LOGIN_TYPE, GOOGLE_ID, STATUS, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_USERS.NEXTVAL, #{email}, #{passwd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{user_name}, #{real_name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{phone, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{birth, jdbcType=DATE}, #{intro, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{auth}, #{login_type}, #{google_id}, #{status}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET REAL_NAME = #{real_name}, PHONE = #{phone}, BIRTH = #{birth}, MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE USER_NUM = #{user_num} AND LOGIN_TYPE = 2 AND STATUS != 3
UPDATE USERS SET GOOGLE_ID = #{googleId}, LOGIN_TYPE = 3, MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE USER_NUM = #{userNum} AND LOGIN_TYPE = 1 AND GOOGLE_ID IS NULL AND STATUS != 3
UPDATE USERS SET GOOGLE_ID = NULL, LOGIN_TYPE = 1, MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE USER_NUM = #{userNum} AND LOGIN_TYPE = 3 AND GOOGLE_ID IS NOT NULL AND STATUS != 3
